manage to see the artwork up close, they are likely to be (2)________ by the small subdued
portrait of an ordinary woman. She’s dressed modestly in a translucent veil, dark robes, and
no jewellery. Much has been said about her smile and gaze, but viewers still might wonder
what all the (3)_____ is about. Along with the mysteries of the sitter’s identity and her
